'''Viera Cheran''' served as [[Chief Technician]] for [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and crew chief, responsible for overseeing the maintenance of the squadron's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and all flight deck operations. 
==Biography==
[[File:Viera_Cheran_and_Wedge.jpg|thumb|left|Chief Cheran (right) reports to Wedge Antilles]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cheran and her crew served the Rogue Squadron and followed the team from station to station throughout their missions.<ref name="source">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], when ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'' was spotted on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], her team was ordered to build a [[Rebel base (Kile)|temporary base]] on nearby [[Kile]].

In the same time, [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] intended to discredit [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] before [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] eyes. For that end he used his underground connections to bribe [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and anyone else who could track down and kill [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref>''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>

The movements of the Rogue Squadron, as well as Cheran's weariness for her position and dissatisfaction with the pilots, were known to [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], who had contacts within the Alliance. Before a Cheran moved with her crew to Kile, she was approached by someone from the fleet, who was actually one of Black Sun's moles, offering her 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] dead by "technical malfunction", promising 40,000 afterwards. She saw killing Skywalker as a means to get enough money to buy her own [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] and become a [[Free-trader]], working only for herself.<ref name="source" /> Cheran decided to take the bribe. [[Guri]] paid her through a net of dummy corporations, which would be traced to [[Saber Enterprises]].

Shortly before the [[Battle of Gall]], she tampered with the [[Unidentified R2 unit (Wes Janson)|R2 unit]] of [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighter]] so that it would take control and fire on Skywalker's. As the battle concluded, Janson's R2 took control of the X-wing and started to hunt and shoot Luke's. However Luke managed to get behind him and shoot a precise hit to his R2.

Investigating on the aftermath, Luke and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge]] found that Janson's droid had been programmed by their technician. When they went to interrogate her, she attempted to shoot Luke, before being shot by Wedge.

After that incident, they investigated her account and tracked down the bribe to Saber Enterprises. Xizor's plan was foiled, however as he intended, everyone believed that Vader was behind the attempt.

==Personality and traits==
Known to many as simply "Chief", Cheran was efficient overseeing and directing her tech experts and maintaining the much aged and abused Rogue X-wings in their optimal condition.<ref name="source" />

However she believed her job to be a thankless one. The fighter pilots got all the glory, while she and her "invisible" crew got none. Always following the Rogue X-wings from cruiser hangars or planetary bases, they always had to carry and transport all the equipment and have it ready for the "visible" heroes. Sometimes she dreamed about stopping running from the Empire and trying to keep the ungrateful Rogues happy, purchase a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] and live as a free trader.<ref name="source" />
